name: Hand over to the team
summary: Hands the caller to a person when they ask, are upset or the matter is urgent, shows the hand-over on the panel and, with a team webhook key, tells your team.

defaults.name: webhook_secret_name
defaults.label: Name of the webhook in the key
defaults.help: Only with a key: the name your team's webhook address is stored under in the tool-secret key you pick.

instructions_snippet: If the caller asks for a person, is upset, or the matter is urgent or about safety, tell them you are bringing in the team and call escalate_to_human with a one-line reason. Do not argue or try to talk them out of it.

variables.name: needs_person
variables.label: Wants a person
variables.hint: true when the caller asks for a person, is upset or distressed, or the matter is urgent or about safety, and otherwise leave it empty

rules.label: Hand over when a person is needed

then.reason: The caller asked for a person, or the matter is urgent.

test_case.name: Hands over when asked
test_case.persona_instructions: You are a caller who is frustrated and wants to speak to a person straight away.
test_case.scenario: Ask for a person in your first message.
expectations: The agent says it is bringing in the team instead of arguing.

variants.label: Your team
variants.summary: Uses the built-in hand-over. Pick a tool-secret key holding your team's webhook address to also post a message to the team.
